changelog: Say "elaborate my text" or "make it longer" — or "বড় করো" / "বিস্তারিত করো" in Bengali — alone while dictating in WhatsApp or Messenger and the whole dictated message is rewritten longer and more detailed through Gemini with your own key. Gboard's Pixel 9+ writing-tools "Elaborate" command, the fourth writing-tools rewrite after "fix it", "formalize" and "shorten" — the fix for a message dictated too short and terse. Adds detail drawn only from what you already said, never invents new facts, names or numbers, and keeps your tone.
